name: Park Hyatt Chennai
insider_take: Where Marina Beach meets luxury - Chennai's most sophisticated waterfront retreat
whats_special: This stunning property sits just steps from Marina Beach, the world's second-longest urban beach. The hotel's rooftop infinity pool offers breathtaking views of the Bay of Bengal, while its location puts you minutes from Chennai's cultural heart - including the historic Fort St. George and vibrant Mylapore district known for its ancient Kapaleeshwarar Temple.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Flying Elephant, the hotel's rooftop restaurant. The panoramic views of Marina Beach combined with South Indian coastal cuisine create an unforgettable experience, especially during Chennai's golden hour between 6-7 PM.
dont_miss: Early morning walks along Marina Beach (just 2 minutes away) to catch fishermen bringing in their daily catch, and exploring the nearby San Thome Basilica - one of only three churches in the world built over an apostle's tomb. The hotel's spa also features traditional Ayurvedic treatments using locally-sourced ingredients.
pros: Premium luxury accommodations with sophisticated design
Strategic location in Chennai's business district
Exceptional dining venues and culinary experiences
cons: Urban location may lack beachfront access
